source.text: καὶ ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς· Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι εἰσίν τινες τῶν ὧδε ἑστηκότων οἵτινες οὐ μὴ γεύσωνται θανάτου ἕως ἂν ἴδωσιν τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ θεοῦ ἐληλυθυῖαν ἐν δυνάμει.

records.literal_gloss: And he was saying to them, Truly I say to you that there are some of those here standing who no not shall taste of death until they see the kingdom of God having come with power.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was saying to them, "Truly I say to you that there are some of those standing here who will not taste death until they see the kingdom of God having come with power."
en.B: He went on to say to them, "Truly I tell you, some who stand here will not taste death until the kingdom of God has come in power and they have seen it."
en.R: Then Jesus told them, "I tell you the truth: some people standing here will not die until they see the kingdom of God come with power."

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Thật vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các người rằng có mấy người trong số những người đang đứng đây sẽ không hề nếm sự chết cho đến khi thấy vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời đã đến với quyền năng."
vi.B: Ngài nói tiếp với họ: "Thật vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các người, có mấy người đang đứng đây sẽ không nếm trải sự chết trước khi thấy vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời đã đến trong quyền năng."
vi.R: Rồi Đức Giê-xu nói với họ: "Ta nói thật với các người: có mấy người đang đứng đây sẽ không chết trước khi thấy vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời đến với quyền năng."

ko.L: 그리고 그분이 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "진실로 너희에게 말한다. 여기 서 있는 사람들 가운데 몇몇은 하나님의 나라가 능력으로 임한 것을 볼 때까지 결코 죽음을 맛보지 않을 것이다."
ko.B: 예수께서 또 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "진실로 너희에게 말한다. 여기 서 있는 사람들 가운데 몇 사람은, 하나님의 나라가 능력으로 임한 것을 보기 전에는 결코 죽지 않을 것이다."
ko.R: 예수께서 또 말씀하셨다. "내가 분명히 말한다. 여기 서 있는 사람들 가운데 몇 사람은 죽기 전에 하나님의 나라가 능력 있게 오는 것을 볼 것이다."

es.L: Y les decía: «En verdad {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que hay algunos de los que están aquí que no probarán la muerte hasta que vean el reino de Dios venido con poder».
es.B: Y añadió: «En verdad {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que algunos de los que están aquí no probarán la muerte hasta que vean que el reino de Dios ha llegado con poder».
es.R: Luego Jesús les dijo: «{{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo la verdad: algunos de los que están aquí no morirán sin antes ver el reino de Dios llegar con poder».

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur disait : « En vérité, je vous le dis : il y a quelques-uns de ceux qui se tiennent ici qui ne goûteront pas la mort avant d’avoir vu le royaume de Dieu venu avec puissance. »
fr.B: Il leur dit encore : « En vérité, je vous le dis : quelques-uns de ceux qui sont ici ne goûteront pas la mort avant d’avoir vu le royaume de Dieu venu avec puissance. »
fr.R: Puis Jésus leur a dit : « Je vous le dis, c’est la vérité : certaines personnes qui sont ici ne mourront pas avant d’avoir vu le royaume de Dieu venir avec puissance. »

sw.L: Na alikuwa akiwaambia, "Kweli nawaambia kwamba wapo baadhi ya hao waliosimama hapa ambao hawataonja mauti kamwe mpaka watakapouona ufalme wa Mungu ukiwa umekuja kwa nguvu."
sw.B: Akaendelea kuwaambia, "Kweli nawaambia, baadhi ya wale waliosimama hapa hawataonja kifo kabla ya kuuona ufalme wa Mungu umekuja kwa nguvu."
sw.R: Kisha Yesu akawaambia, "Nawaambia ukweli: baadhi ya watu waliosimama hapa hawatakufa kabla ya kuuona ufalme wa Mungu ukija kwa nguvu."

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes dizia: "Em verdade eu lhes digo que há alguns dos que estão aqui que de modo nenhum provarão a morte até que vejam o Reino de Deus vindo com poder."
pt.B: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} continuou: "Em verdade eu lhes digo: alguns dos que estão aqui não provarão a morte antes de verem o Reino de Deus, que terá chegado com poder."
pt.R: Então Jesus lhes disse: "Eu garanto a vocês: algumas pessoas que estão aqui não vão morrer antes de ver o Reino de Deus chegar com poder."

decisions.choice: the kingdom come with power: most likely what the three disciples see on the mountain six days later (9:2-8), a first view of the kingdom in power
alternatives: Jesus' resurrection and the coming of the Spirit
the final coming of the Son of Man in 8:38
decisions.reason: Mark sets this saying directly before the transfiguration and ties the two together with "after six days" (9:2). Only "some" will see it, and only three disciples go up the mountain. Others read the saying as pointing to the resurrection and what followed it, or to the final coming spoken of in 8:38. The text does not settle the question.

decisions.choice: taste death: die
decisions.reason: To taste death is a way of saying to experience death, to die.

decisions.choice: will not: a double negative, a strong denial
decisions.reason: Two negatives together make a firm promise: they will certainly not die first.

decisions.choice: having come: a perfect participle, the kingdom seen as already arrived
decisions.reason: They will see the kingdom as something that has come and is present in power.

decisions.choice: he was saying to them: the saying closes the teaching of 8:34-38
alternatives: the start of a new scene
decisions.reason: The chapter break comes in the middle of a speech. Jesus is still speaking to the crowd and the disciples of 8:34.

decisions.choice: Truly I tell you (B); I tell you the truth (R)
decisions.reason: The same forms as at 3:28. Readable says "not die" for the idiom "taste death".

decisions.choice: "Thật vậy, Ta nói với..." (L, B); "Ta nói thật với..." (R) for the single "Truly I say to you"
decisions.reason: John's double "Truly, truly" is "Thật vậy, thật vậy" in Vietnamese; Mark's single word takes one "Thật vậy". Readable puts it as a plain promise, as in John. The same through Mark 9.

decisions.choice: "vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời" for the kingdom of God, at every level
decisions.reason: As John 3:3 and 3:5. "vương quốc" is the plain modern word for a king's rule and realm; the same through Mark 9-10.

decisions.choice: "các người" for "you"
decisions.reason: The saying closes the teaching of 8:34-38, which Jesus gave to the crowd together with his disciples, so he uses the word for a crowd, as in John.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Korean; the narrative honours Jesus with "께서" and -시-, Jesus speaks in the plain style (해라체), people speak to him in 합쇼체, and Mark's historic presents stay present only at Literal ("말씀하신다", "데리고 가신다"), through chapter 9
alternatives: capitalised pronoun spans as in English
decisions.reason: Korean has no capital letters, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change (style guide, sections 4 and 7). Literal keeps Mark's present tense in narrative (9:2, 9:19, 9:35); Balanced and Readable use the past. Recorded once for the chapter.

decisions.choice: "진실로 너희에게 말한다" (L, B); "내가 분명히 말한다" (R); "하나님의 나라" at every level, through chapter 9
decisions.reason: The single "amen" of Mark takes the form the Korean John uses for its double one, with a modern ending in place of the archaic "이르노니". "하나님의 나라" is the form of the Korean John (3:3, 3:5).

decisions.choice: En verdad les digo (L, B); Les digo la verdad (R)
decisions.reason: Mark's single "amen": the wording John's Spanish uses for the double one, said once. Every plural "you" in this chapter is the ustedes / vosotros setting, and every pronoun for Jesus or for God that Spanish writes as a separate word takes the deity_pronoun setting, by the rule set for Mark at 1:2.

decisions.choice: probarán la muerte (L, B); morirán (R)
decisions.reason: As in English: Literal and Balanced keep the idiom (meaning decision on "taste death"); Readable says what it means.

decisions.choice: narration in the passé simple (L, B), with Literal keeping Mark’s present tense where the Greek has it ("Jésus emmène", "il dit"); passé composé (R); speech in the passé composé at every level
alternatives: passé composé for narration at every level
the present tense throughout at Literal
decisions.reason: The French tense choice for the whole chapter, as in John. The passé simple is the normal tense of written narrative and suits public reading; Literal keeps the present where Mark tells a past event in the present (9:2, 9:19, 9:35), as the English Literal does. Readable uses the passé composé, the past tense French readers speak and learn first. The imperfect ("disait", "enseignait") is used at every level for what was going on.

decisions.choice: En vérité, je vous le dis (L, B); Je vous le dis, c’est la vérité (R)
decisions.reason: The single "Truly" of Mark, rendered as the French John renders the double one, without the repetition: Literal and Balanced keep the solemn formula, Readable says plainly that what follows is true. Used the same way in 9:41.

decisions.choice: Kweli nawaambia (L, B); Nawaambia ukweli (R)
decisions.reason: The single amen is a solemn pledge. "Kweli nawaambia" says it in plain Swahili, one "kweli" where John's double amen has "kweli kweli"; Readable says "I tell you the truth", as the English Readable does. Used for every amen saying in Mark 9 and 10.

decisions.choice: deity_pronoun spans only on free pronouns and possessives (wake, yake, kwake, mimi, wewe)
alternatives: a span on every pronoun, as in English
decisions.reason: As in John: Swahili marks most pronouns for Jesus inside the verb ("alikuwa akiwaambia", "wakamwuliza"), and a prefix cannot take a capital, so this chapter has fewer setting spans than the English.

decisions.choice: Em verdade eu lhes digo (L, B); Eu garanto a vocês (R)
decisions.reason: The same forms as Matthew 16:28, the parallel saying (docs/portuguese-style.md, section 6). Literal and Balanced keep the idiom "provar a morte" (m2); Readable says "morrer", as the English Readable does.

source.text: Καὶ μετὰ ἡμέρας ἓξ παραλαμβάνει ὁ Ἰησοῦς τὸν Πέτρον καὶ τὸν Ἰάκωβον καὶ Ἰωάννην, καὶ ἀναφέρει αὐτοὺς εἰς ὄρος ὑψηλὸν κατ’ ἰδίαν μόνους.

records.literal_gloss: And after days six takes along Jesus Peter and James and John, and brings up them into a mountain high, apart, alone.

en.L: And after six days Jesus takes along Peter and James and John and brings them up onto a high mountain, apart, by themselves.
en.B: Six days later Jesus took Peter, James and John with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and led them up a high mountain, away from everyone else.
en.R: Six days later, Jesus took Peter, James, and John with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and they climbed a high mountain. Only the four of them were there.

vi.L: Và sau sáu ngày, Đức Giê-xu đem theo Phi-e-rơ, Gia-cơ và Giăng, rồi dẫn họ lên một ngọn núi cao, riêng biệt, chỉ một mình họ.
vi.B: Sáu ngày sau, Đức Giê-xu đem Phi-e-rơ, Gia-cơ và Giăng đi với mình và dẫn họ lên một ngọn núi cao, tách khỏi mọi người.
vi.R: Sáu ngày sau, Đức Giê-xu dẫn Phi-e-rơ, Gia-cơ và Giăng đi với mình, và họ leo lên một ngọn núi cao. Ở đó chỉ có bốn thầy trò mà thôi.

ko.L: 그리고 엿새 후에 예수께서 베드로와 야고보와 요한을 데리고 가신다. 그리고 그들만 따로 데리고 높은 산으로 올라가신다.
ko.B: 엿새 뒤에 예수께서는 베드로와 야고보와 요한만 따로 데리고 높은 산에 올라가셨다.
ko.R: 엿새가 지난 뒤에 예수께서 베드로와 야고보와 요한을 데리고 높은 산에 올라가셨다. 그곳에는 그 네 사람만 있었다.

es.L: Y seis días después, Jesús toma consigo a Pedro, a Santiago y a Juan, y los sube a un monte alto, aparte, a ellos solos.
es.B: Seis días después, Jesús tomó consigo a Pedro, a Santiago y a Juan, y los llevó a un monte alto, lejos de los demás.
es.R: Seis días después, Jesús se llevó a Pedro, a Santiago y a Juan, y subieron a un monte alto. Solo estaban ellos cuatro allí.

fr.L: Et après six jours, Jésus emmène Pierre et Jacques et Jean, et les fait monter sur une haute montagne, à l’écart, seuls.
fr.B: Six jours plus tard, Jésus prit avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} Pierre, Jacques et Jean, et les conduisit sur une haute montagne, à l’écart de tous.
fr.R: Six jours plus tard, Jésus a emmené Pierre, Jacques et Jean. Ils sont montés sur une haute montagne. Ils étaient seuls, tous les quatre.

sw.L: Na baada ya siku sita Yesu anawachukua Petro na Yakobo na Yohana, na anawapandisha juu ya mlima mrefu, faraghani, wao peke yao.
sw.B: Siku sita baadaye Yesu aliwachukua Petro, Yakobo na Yohana, akawapeleka juu ya mlima mrefu, mbali na watu wengine.
sw.R: Siku sita baadaye, Yesu aliwachukua Petro, Yakobo na Yohana, wakapanda mlima mrefu. Walikuwa huko wanne peke yao.

pt.L: E, depois de seis dias, Jesus toma consigo Pedro, Tiago e João e os leva para cima de um monte alto, à parte, sozinhos.
pt.B: Seis dias depois, Jesus levou consigo Pedro, Tiago e João e subiu com eles a um monte alto, longe de todos.
pt.R: Seis dias depois, Jesus levou Pedro, Tiago e João com {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}, e eles subiram um monte alto. Só os quatro estavam ali.

decisions.choice: takes along, brings up: present tense in a story about the past
decisions.reason: As often in Mark, past events are told in the present tense to make them vivid. The sense is past: he took them and led them up.

decisions.choice: after six days: counted from the sayings of 8:27-9:1; it may also recall Moses on Mount Sinai
decisions.reason: Mark rarely gives exact times. In Exodus 24:15-16 the cloud covered Sinai for six days before God called Moses out of the cloud. With the cloud and the voice in 9:7, the echo may be intended.

decisions.choice: a high mountain: Mark does not name it
decisions.reason: Later tradition named Mount Tabor in Galilee. Mount Hermon lies near Caesarea Philippi, where the last scene took place (8:27). Mark leaves it unnamed.

decisions.choice: apart, alone: privately, just the four of them
decisions.reason: Two phrases together stress that no one else was there, as in 4:34 and 6:31.

decisions.choice: Only the four of them were there
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly who was on the mountain.

decisions.choice: historic present: "đem theo", "dẫn" with no "đã" (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps Mark's present tense by leaving out the past marker; Balanced and Readable tell the story in the past through the context. The same through Mark 9.

decisions.choice: "Phi-e-rơ, Gia-cơ và Giăng"
decisions.reason: The Protestant forms of the names, settled for the whole Bible.

decisions.choice: "bốn thầy trò" (the four, teacher and disciples)
decisions.reason: Vietnamese has a natural word for a teacher with his students together, which says what "apart, alone" means here.

decisions.choice: "그곳에는 그 네 사람만 있었다"
decisions.reason: Readable spells out "apart, alone" as the English Readable does: no one else was with them.

decisions.choice: historic present at Literal (toma, sube); pretérito at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: Mark often tells past events in the present. Literal keeps it; Balanced and Readable use the pretérito, as Spanish narrative does. This applies throughout the chapter.

decisions.choice: Santiago
decisions.reason: The usual Spanish name for James, son of Zebedee.

decisions.choice: historic present kept at Literal (anawachukua, anawapandisha); past at Balanced and Readable (aliwachukua, akawapeleka)
decisions.reason: Mark often tells past events in the present. Literal keeps it, as the English Literal does; Balanced and Readable use the narrative past with -ka-, which is how written Swahili tells a story. This holds for the whole chapter.

source.text: καὶ μετεμορφώθη ἔμπροσθεν αὐτῶν, καὶ τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ ἐγένετο στίλβοντα λευκὰ λίαν οἷα γναφεὺς ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς οὐ δύναται οὕτως λευκᾶναι.

records.literal_gloss: And he was transfigured before them, \v 3 and the garments of him became shining, white exceedingly, such as a launderer on the earth not is able thus to whiten.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was transfigured before them, \v 3 and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} garments became shining, exceedingly white, such as no launderer on earth is able to whiten [them].
en.B: There {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was transfigured in front of them. \v 3 His clothes turned dazzling and intensely white, white beyond what any launderer on earth could achieve.
en.R: There, while they watched, Jesus' appearance was changed. \v 3 His clothes began to shine. They became whiter than anyone on earth could ever wash them.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được biến hình trước mặt họ, \v 3 và y phục của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trở nên sáng chói, trắng tinh, như không thợ giặt nào trên đất có thể tẩy trắng như thế.
vi.B: Tại đó, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} biến hình trước mặt họ. \v 3 Áo của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trở nên sáng chói và trắng tinh, trắng hơn bất cứ thợ giặt nào trên đất có thể tẩy được.
vi.R: Tại đó, ngay trước mắt họ, diện mạo của Đức Giê-xu thay đổi. \v 3 Áo của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bắt đầu chiếu sáng. Áo trắng hơn bất cứ ai trên đất có thể giặt được.

ko.L: 그리고 그들 앞에서 그분의 모습이 변하셨다. \v 3 그리고 그분의 옷이 광채를 내며 매우 희게 되었는데, 세상의 어떤 표백하는 사람도 그렇게 희게 할 수 없을 만큼 [희었다].
ko.B: 그곳에서 그들이 보는 앞에서 예수의 모습이 변하셨다. \v 3 그분의 옷은 눈부시게 빛나며 새하얗게 되었는데, 세상의 어떤 빨래꾼도 그렇게 희게 할 수 없을 만큼 희었다.
ko.R: 그들이 보는 앞에서 예수의 모습이 달라지셨다. \v 3 예수의 옷이 빛나기 시작했다. 옷이 너무 하얘져서, 세상 누구도 빨래를 해서 그렇게 하얗게 만들 수 없을 정도였다.

es.L: Y fue transfigurado delante de ellos, \v 3 y {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} vestidos se volvieron resplandecientes, sumamente blancos, como ningún lavandero en la tierra puede blanquear[los].
es.B: Allí fue transfigurado delante de ellos. \v 3 Su ropa se volvió deslumbrante y blanquísima, más blanca de lo que ningún lavandero en la tierra podría dejarla.
es.R: Allí, mientras ellos miraban, el aspecto de Jesús cambió. \v 3 Su ropa empezó a brillar. Se volvió más blanca de lo que nadie en la tierra podría jamás lavarla.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fut transfiguré devant eux, \v 3 et {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} vêtements devinrent resplendissants, extrêmement blancs, tels qu’aucun foulon sur la terre ne peut ainsi blanchir.
fr.B: Là, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fut transfiguré devant eux. \v 3 Ses vêtements devinrent éclatants, d’une blancheur intense, plus blancs qu’aucun blanchisseur sur terre ne pourrait les rendre.
fr.R: Là, pendant qu’ils regardaient, l’apparence de Jésus a changé. \v 3 Ses vêtements se sont mis à briller. Ils sont devenus plus blancs que personne sur terre ne pourrait les laver.

sw.L: Na akageuzwa sura mbele yao, \v 3 na mavazi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} yakawa yanang'aa, meupe mno, kiasi ambacho hakuna dobi duniani awezaye kuyafanya meupe hivyo.
sw.B: Huko aligeuzwa sura mbele yao. \v 3 Mavazi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} yakawa yanang'aa na meupe kabisa, meupe kuliko dobi yeyote duniani awezavyo kuyafanya.
sw.R: Huko, wakiwa wanatazama, sura ya Yesu ilibadilika. \v 3 Nguo {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} zikaanza kung'aa. Zikawa nyeupe kuliko mtu yeyote duniani awezavyo kuzifua.

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} foi transfigurado diante deles, \v 3 e as {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} roupas ficaram resplandecentes, extremamente brancas, como nenhum lavadeiro na terra é capaz de branquear.
pt.B: Ali, diante dos olhos deles, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} foi transfigurado. \v 3 As {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} roupas ficaram brilhantes e muito brancas, mais brancas do que qualquer lavadeiro no mundo conseguiria deixá-las.
pt.R: Ali, enquanto eles olhavam, a aparência de Jesus mudou. \v 3 As roupas {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} começaram a brilhar. Ficaram mais brancas do que qualquer pessoa no mundo conseguiria lavar.

decisions.choice: transfigured: his form was changed so that a heavenly glory showed
alternatives: he only looked different in the light
decisions.reason: The verb means to change form. Paul uses it of believers being changed into the Lord's likeness (2 Corinthians 3:18). Mark describes only the clothes, but the change is in Jesus himself.

decisions.choice: was transfigured: a passive, God is the one who changed him
decisions.reason: The passive leaves the actor unnamed, a common way of speaking of God's action.

decisions.choice: launderer: a fuller, who cleaned and bleached new wool and cloth
decisions.reason: Fullers whitened cloth with lye and fuller's earth. Even their best work could not match this whiteness.

decisions.choice: shining white clothes: the clothing of heaven
decisions.reason: White clothing marks God and heavenly beings (Daniel 7:9; Mark 16:5).

decisions.choice: transfigured
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the word long used for this event. Readable says what it means: his appearance was changed.

decisions.choice: "được biến hình" (L), "biến hình" (B); "diện mạo ... thay đổi" (R)
decisions.reason: "biến hình" is the familiar word for the transfiguration; Literal adds "được" to show the Greek passive (God changed him). Readable says plainly that his appearance changed.

decisions.choice: "모습이 변하다" for "transfigured"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision says that his form was changed; "모습이 변하다" says that in plain Korean at every level, where "변형" sounds technical. The passive is kept in sense: God is the one who changed him.

decisions.choice: "표백하는 사람" (L); "빨래꾼" (B)
decisions.reason: The fuller cleaned and bleached cloth (meaning decision). Literal names what he did; Balanced uses the everyday word for one who washes clothes, and Readable just speaks of washing.

decisions.choice: fue transfigurado
decisions.reason: As in English: Literal and Balanced keep the passive and the familiar word; Readable says plainly that his appearance changed.

decisions.choice: lavandero
decisions.reason: Says what the man did in words every reader knows; the meaning decision explains the fuller's trade.

decisions.choice: foulon (L); blanchisseur (B)
decisions.reason: "Foulon" is the exact French word for the craftsman who cleaned and whitened cloth (meaning decision on the launderer); Balanced uses the everyday "blanchisseur", and Readable says it without naming the trade.

decisions.choice: aligeuzwa sura (his form was changed)
decisions.reason: Swahili has no single word for "transfigured". "Kugeuzwa sura" says that his form was changed and keeps the passive, so God remains the one who changed him, as the meaning decision says. Readable says plainly that his appearance changed.

decisions.choice: lavadeiro (L, B); qualquer pessoa ... lavar (R)
decisions.reason: "Pisoeiro", the old word for a fuller (m3), is unknown to most readers, and "tintureiro" now means a dry cleaner. "Lavadeiro", someone who washes cloth for a living, gives the picture; Readable drops the trade, as the English Readable does.

source.text: καὶ ὤφθη αὐτοῖς Ἠλίας σὺν Μωϋσεῖ, καὶ ἦσαν συλλαλοῦντες τῷ Ἰησοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: And appeared to them Elijah with Moses, and they were talking with Jesus.

en.L: And Elijah with Moses appeared to them, and they were talking with Jesus.
en.B: Then Elijah appeared to them along with Moses, and the two were talking with Jesus.
en.R: Then the disciples saw Elijah and Moses there. These two great men from long ago were talking with Jesus.

vi.L: Và Ê-li cùng với Môi-se hiện ra cho họ [thấy], và họ đang trò chuyện với Đức Giê-xu.
vi.B: Rồi Ê-li cùng Môi-se hiện ra trước mắt họ, và hai người đang trò chuyện với Đức Giê-xu.
vi.R: Rồi các môn đồ thấy Ê-li và Môi-se ở đó. Hai vĩ nhân thời xưa này đang trò chuyện với Đức Giê-xu.

ko.L: 그리고 엘리야가 모세와 함께 그들에게 나타났고, 그들은 예수와 함께 이야기하고 있었다.
ko.B: 그때 엘리야가 모세와 함께 그들에게 나타나서, 예수와 이야기를 나누고 있었다.
ko.R: 그때 제자들은 엘리야와 모세가 거기 있는 것을 보았다. 오래전에 살았던 이 두 위대한 사람이 예수와 이야기하고 있었다.

es.L: Y se les apareció Elías con Moisés, y estaban conversando con Jesús.
es.B: Entonces se les apareció Elías junto con Moisés, y los dos conversaban con Jesús.
es.R: Entonces los discípulos vieron allí a Elías y a Moisés. Estos dos grandes hombres de hace mucho tiempo estaban hablando con Jesús.

fr.L: Et Élie leur apparut avec Moïse, et ils s’entretenaient avec Jésus.
fr.B: Alors Élie leur apparut avec Moïse, et tous deux parlaient avec Jésus.
fr.R: Puis les disciples ont vu Élie et Moïse. Ces deux grands hommes d’autrefois parlaient avec Jésus.

sw.L: Na Eliya akawatokea pamoja na Musa, nao walikuwa wakizungumza na Yesu.
sw.B: Kisha Eliya akawatokea pamoja na Musa, na hao wawili walikuwa wakizungumza na Yesu.
sw.R: Kisha wanafunzi waliwaona Eliya na Musa pale. Watu hawa wawili wakuu wa zamani walikuwa wakizungumza na Yesu.

pt.L: E apareceu-lhes Elias com Moisés, e estavam conversando com Jesus.
pt.B: Então Elias lhes apareceu junto com Moisés, e os dois conversavam com Jesus.
pt.R: Então os discípulos viram Elias e Moisés ali. Esses dois grandes homens do passado estavam conversando com Jesus.

decisions.choice: Elijah and Moses: the great prophet and the giver of the law
decisions.reason: Malachi 4:4-5 names Moses and Elijah together at the close of the prophets. Both met God on a mountain (Exodus 24; 1 Kings 19:8), and neither had an ordinary burial (Deuteronomy 34:6; 2 Kings 2:11).

decisions.choice: Elijah with Moses: Elijah is named first
decisions.reason: Mark names Elijah first. Elijah's coming is what the disciples ask about on the way down (9:11-13).

decisions.choice: appeared: they were seen, a word used of heavenly appearances
decisions.reason: The word means was seen. It is used of appearances from God, such as the risen Jesus (1 Corinthians 15:5).

decisions.choice: the disciples saw; these two great men from long ago
decisions.reason: Readable names who saw them and says who Elijah and Moses were.

decisions.choice: "제자들은 ... 보았다"; "오래전에 살았던 이 두 위대한 사람"
decisions.reason: As the English Readable: Readable says who saw them and who Elijah and Moses were.

decisions.choice: apareceu-lhes
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek order, verb first, and Portuguese then puts the pronoun after the verb, since no written sentence or clause opens with an unstressed pronoun. Balanced uses the ordinary order "Elias lhes apareceu".

source.text: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ Πέτρος λέγει τῷ Ἰησοῦ· Ῥαββί, καλόν ἐστιν ἡμᾶς ὧδε εἶναι, καὶ ποιήσωμεν τρεῖς σκηνάς, σοὶ μίαν καὶ Μωϋσεῖ μίαν καὶ Ἠλίᾳ μίαν.

records.literal_gloss: And answering Peter says to Jesus, Rabbi, good it is for us here to be, and let us make three tents, for you one and for Moses one and for Elijah one.

en.L: And Peter responds and says to Jesus, "Rabbi, it is good for us to be here, and let us make three tents, one for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} and one for Moses and one for Elijah."
en.B: Peter spoke up and said to Jesus, "Rabbi, how good it is that we are here! Let us set up three shelters, one for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} and one for Moses and one for Elijah."
en.R: Peter said to Jesus, "Teacher, this is a good place for us to be. We will make three shelters. One will be for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, another for Moses, and a third for Elijah."

vi.L: Và Phi-e-rơ đáp lời, nói với Đức Giê-xu: "Thưa Ra-bi, chúng con ở đây thật là tốt; vậy chúng con xin dựng ba cái lều, một cho Thầy, một cho Môi-se và một cho Ê-li."
vi.B: Phi-e-rơ lên tiếng thưa với Đức Giê-xu: "Thưa Ra-bi, chúng con được ở đây thật tốt quá! Chúng con xin dựng ba cái lều tạm, một cái cho Thầy, một cái cho Môi-se và một cái cho Ê-li."
vi.R: Phi-e-rơ thưa với Đức Giê-xu: "Thưa Thầy, ở đây thật là tốt cho chúng con. Chúng con sẽ dựng ba cái lều: một cái cho Thầy, một cái cho Môi-se, và một cái cho Ê-li."

ko.L: 그리고 베드로가 대답하여 예수께 말한다. "랍비, 저희가 여기 있는 것이 좋습니다. 그러니 초막 셋을 짓겠습니다. 하나는 선생님을 위해, 하나는 모세를 위해, 하나는 엘리야를 위해서입니다."
ko.B: 베드로가 예수께 말했다. "랍비님, 저희가 여기 있으니 참 좋습니다! 초막 셋을 지어서, 하나는 선생님께, 하나는 모세께, 하나는 엘리야께 드리겠습니다."
ko.R: 베드로가 예수께 말했다. "랍비님, 여기 있으니 정말 좋습니다. 저희가 나뭇가지로 작은 초막 세 채를 짓겠습니다. 하나는 선생님 것, 하나는 모세 것, 하나는 엘리야 것입니다."

es.L: Y respondiendo Pedro, dice a Jesús: «Rabí, bueno es que nosotros estemos aquí; hagamos tres tiendas, una para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, una para Moisés y una para Elías».
es.B: Pedro tomó la palabra y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dijo a Jesús: «Rabí, ¡qué bueno que estemos aquí! Hagamos tres chozas: una para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, otra para Moisés y otra para Elías».
es.R: Pedro {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dijo a Jesús: «Maestro, este es un buen lugar para nosotros. Vamos a hacer tres chozas: una será para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, otra para Moisés y otra para Elías».

fr.L: Et prenant la parole, Pierre dit à Jésus : « Rabbi, il est bon que nous soyons ici, et faisons trois tentes, une pour {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} et une pour Moïse et une pour Élie. »
fr.B: Pierre prit la parole et dit à Jésus : « Rabbi, qu’il est bon que nous soyons ici ! Dressons trois abris : un pour {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, un pour Moïse et un pour Élie. »
fr.R: Pierre a dit à Jésus : « Rabbi, c’est bien que nous soyons ici. Nous allons faire trois abris : un pour {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, un pour Moïse et un pour Élie. »

sw.L: Na Petro akijibu anamwambia Yesu, "Rabi, ni vizuri sisi kuwa hapa; na tufanye hema tatu, moja kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, na moja kwa ajili ya Musa, na moja kwa ajili ya Eliya."
sw.B: Petro akamwambia Yesu, "Rabi, ni vizuri kama nini sisi kuwa hapa! Tujenge vibanda vitatu: kimoja {{deity_pronoun:chako|Chako}}, kimoja cha Musa na kimoja cha Eliya."
sw.R: Petro akamwambia Yesu, "Rabi, ni vizuri sisi kuwa mahali hapa. Tutajenga vibanda vitatu. Kimoja kitakuwa {{deity_pronoun:chako|Chako}}, kingine cha Musa, na cha tatu cha Eliya."

pt.L: E Pedro, respondendo, diz a Jesus: "Rabi, é bom estarmos aqui; e façamos três tendas, uma para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, e uma para Moisés, e uma para Elias."
pt.B: Pedro tomou a palavra e disse a Jesus: "Rabi, como é bom estarmos aqui! Vamos armar três abrigos: um para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, um para Moisés e um para Elias."
pt.R: Pedro disse a Jesus: "Mestre, este é um bom lugar para nós. Vamos fazer três abrigos. Um vai ser para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, outro para Moisés e outro para Elias."

decisions.choice: answering: speaking up, though no question was asked
decisions.reason: The word often simply introduces what someone says in response to a situation.

decisions.choice: Rabbi: a Hebrew title of respect, my master, used for a teacher
decisions.reason: The title means my great one. It was used for teachers of the law and is the first time Mark uses it for Jesus.

decisions.choice: tents: shelters, such as huts of branches
decisions.reason: The word means a tent or booth. Peter seems to want to keep the moment and the visitors there.

decisions.choice: tents: perhaps recalling the Festival of Booths or the tent where God met Moses
decisions.reason: Israel lived in shelters at the Festival of Booths (Leviticus 23:42-43), and God spoke with Moses in a tent (Exodus 33:7-11). Mark does not say what Peter had in mind.

decisions.choice: one for you, one for Moses, one for Elijah: Peter puts the three side by side
decisions.reason: Peter treats the three as equals. The voice from the cloud corrects this (9:7).

decisions.choice: shelters
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use a word for a simple temporary structure. Readable also says "Teacher" for the Hebrew title Rabbi.

decisions.choice: "Thưa Ra-bi" (L, B), "Thưa Thầy" (R); "Thầy" for "you" and "chúng con" for "us", with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: The disciples speak to Jesus as their teacher, as in John; "Thầy" is a noun of address and takes no setting span.

decisions.choice: "lều tạm" (B); "lều" (L, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced makes clear these are simple shelters for a stay, not tents for a journey.

decisions.choice: "랍비" (L); "랍비님" (B, R); Peter speaks in 합쇼체 and says "선생님" for "you"
decisions.reason: As in the Korean John (1:38; 11:8): "랍비" as an address takes "님" at Balanced and Readable, and a disciple does not call his teacher "you" in Korean, so "선생님" stands for the pronoun and is not bracketed.

decisions.choice: "초막"; Readable adds "나뭇가지로 (지은) 작은"
decisions.reason: The tents are shelters such as huts of branches (meaning decision); "초막" is that kind of shelter and the word of the Festival of Booths, which the meaning decision says may be in view. "천막" suggests canvas.

decisions.choice: tiendas (L); chozas (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the word that recalls the Festival of Booths; Balanced and Readable name simple shelters of branches (meaning decision on "tents").

decisions.choice: Rabbi (R)
alternatives: Maître (R), as the English Readable says "Teacher"
decisions.reason: The French guide keeps "Rabbi" at every level, as the French John does; the title is familiar to French readers and Mark leaves it untranslated. The Greek word for "Teacher" is rendered "Maître" (9:17).

decisions.choice: hema (L); vibanda (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Hema" is the tent of the Greek word and keeps the link with the tent of meeting the meaning decision mentions; Balanced and Readable say "vibanda", small shelters such as huts of branches, as the English says "shelters".

decisions.choice: Rabi at every level
decisions.reason: The English Readable says "Teacher"; the Swahili keeps "Rabi" at every level, as Swahili John does, because the word is familiar and Mark uses the title again (11:21; 14:45).

source.text: οὐ γὰρ ᾔδει τί ἀποκριθῇ, ἔκφοβοι γὰρ ἐγένοντο.

records.literal_gloss: Not for he knew what he should answer, terrified for they became.

en.L: For he did not know what he should answer, for they had become terrified.
en.B: He did not know what to say, because they were all badly frightened.
en.R: Peter did not know what to say, because the three of them were very afraid.

vi.L: Vì ông không biết phải đáp lại gì, vì họ đã trở nên quá sợ hãi.
vi.B: Ông không biết phải nói gì, vì cả ba đều kinh hãi.
vi.R: Phi-e-rơ không biết phải nói gì, vì cả ba người đều rất sợ.

ko.L: 그가 무엇이라고 대답해야 할지 알지 못했기 때문이다. 그들이 몹시 두려워하게 되었기 때문이다.
ko.B: 베드로는 무슨 말을 해야 할지 몰랐다. 그들이 모두 몹시 겁에 질려 있었기 때문이다.
ko.R: 베드로는 무슨 말을 해야 할지 몰랐다. 세 사람 모두 너무 무서웠기 때문이다.

es.L: Porque no sabía qué responder, pues se habían quedado aterrados.
es.B: No sabía qué decir, porque todos estaban muy asustados.
es.R: Pedro no sabía qué decir, porque los tres tenían mucho miedo.

fr.L: Car il ne savait pas quoi répondre, car ils avaient été saisis de frayeur.
fr.B: Il ne savait pas quoi dire, car ils étaient tous terrifiés.
fr.R: Pierre ne savait pas quoi dire, parce que tous les trois avaient très peur.

sw.L: Kwa maana hakujua atakalojibu, kwa maana walikuwa wameogopa sana.
sw.B: Hakujua aseme nini, kwa sababu wote walikuwa wameingiwa na hofu kuu.
sw.R: Petro hakujua aseme nini, kwa sababu wote watatu waliogopa sana.

pt.L: Pois ele não sabia o que responder, pois tinham ficado aterrorizados.
pt.B: Ele não sabia o que dizer, porque todos estavam apavorados.
pt.R: Pedro não sabia o que dizer, porque os três estavam com muito medo.

decisions.choice: for ... for: Mark explains Peter's words
decisions.reason: Mark gives two reasons: Peter did not know what to say, and they were terrified. His offer came from fear and confusion.

decisions.choice: terrified: overcome with fear
decisions.reason: The word is a strong one, used of Moses trembling at Sinai (Hebrews 12:21).

decisions.choice: answer: respond, say
decisions.reason: As in 9:5, the verb means to speak in response to what was happening.

decisions.choice: Peter; the three of them
decisions.reason: Readable names who is meant.

source.text: καὶ ἐγένετο νεφέλη ἐπισκιάζουσα αὐτοῖς, καὶ ἐγένετο φωνὴ ἐκ τῆς νεφέλης· Οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ υἱός μου ὁ ἀγαπητός, ἀκούετε αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: And there came a cloud overshadowing them, and there came a voice out of the cloud, This is the Son of me, the beloved; listen to him.

en.L: And a cloud came, overshadowing them, and a voice came out of the cloud: "This is {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Son, the beloved; listen to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}."
en.B: Then a cloud came and cast its shadow over them, and a voice spoke from the cloud: "This is {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} dearly loved Son. Listen to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}."
en.R: Then a cloud came and covered them with its shadow. A voice came from the cloud and said, "This is {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Son, and I love {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. Listen to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}!"

vi.L: Và có một đám mây đến che phủ họ, và có tiếng từ đám mây [phán]: "Đây là Con của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, [Con] yêu dấu; hãy nghe Con ấy."
vi.B: Rồi một đám mây đến, phủ bóng trên họ, và có tiếng từ trong đám mây phán: "Đây là Con yêu dấu của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Hãy nghe lời Con ấy."
vi.R: Rồi một đám mây đến và phủ bóng trên họ. Có tiếng từ đám mây phán: "Đây là Con của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} yêu thương Con ấy. Hãy nghe lời Con ấy!"

ko.L: 그리고 구름이 생겨 그들을 덮어 그늘지게 했고, 구름 속에서 소리가 났다. "이는 내 사랑하는 아들이다. 너희는 그의 말을 들어라."
ko.B: 그때 구름이 일어나 그들을 그늘로 덮었고, 구름 속에서 소리가 들려왔다. "이는 내가 사랑하는 내 아들이다. 그의 말을 들어라."
ko.R: 그때 구름이 와서 그들을 그늘로 덮었다. 구름 속에서 이렇게 말하는 소리가 들렸다. "이는 내 아들이다. 나는 그를 사랑한다. 그의 말을 들어라!"

es.L: Y vino una nube que los cubría con su sombra, y vino una voz desde la nube: «Este es {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Hijo, el amado; {{plural_you:escúchenlo|escuchadlo}}».
es.B: Entonces vino una nube y los cubrió con su sombra, y desde la nube habló una voz: «Este es {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Hijo muy amado. {{plural_you:Escúchenlo|Escuchadlo}}».
es.R: Luego vino una nube y los cubrió con su sombra. Desde la nube, una voz dijo: «Este es {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Hijo, y yo {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} amo. ¡{{plural_you:Escúchenlo|Escuchadlo}}!».

fr.L: Et une nuée survint, les couvrant de son ombre, et une voix vint de la nuée : « Celui-ci est {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Fils, le bien-aimé ; écoutez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}}. »
fr.B: Alors une nuée vint et les couvrit de son ombre, et de la nuée une voix se fit entendre : « Celui-ci est {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Fils bien-aimé. Écoutez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}}. »
fr.R: Puis un nuage est venu et les a couverts de son ombre. Une voix est sortie du nuage et a dit : « Celui-ci est {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Fils, et je {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}aime. Écoutez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} ! »

sw.L: Na wingu likaja likiwatia kivuli, na sauti ikatoka katika wingu: "Huyu ni Mwana {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, mpendwa; msikilizeni {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}."
sw.B: Kisha wingu likaja, likawafunika kwa kivuli chake, na sauti ikasema kutoka katika wingu: "Huyu ni Mwana {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} ninayempenda sana. Msikilizeni {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}!"
sw.R: Kisha wingu likaja, likawafunika kwa kivuli. Sauti ikatoka katika wingu, ikasema, "Huyu ni Mwana {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, ninayempenda. Msikilizeni!"

pt.L: E veio uma nuvem, cobrindo-os com a sua sombra, e veio uma voz da nuvem: "Este é o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} Filho, o amado; escutem-{{deity_pronoun:no|No}}."
pt.B: Então veio uma nuvem e os envolveu com a sua sombra, e uma voz falou da nuvem: "Este é o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} Filho amado. Escutem-{{deity_pronoun:no|No}}."
pt.R: Então veio uma nuvem e os cobriu com a sua sombra. Uma voz saiu da nuvem e disse: "Este é o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} Filho, e eu {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} amo. Escutem o que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} diz!"

decisions.choice: the cloud: the cloud of God's presence
decisions.reason: God came down in a cloud on Sinai and filled the tent of meeting with a cloud (Exodus 24:15-18; 40:34-35). The voice comes from the cloud, so the speaker is God.

decisions.choice: This is my Son, the beloved; listen to him: the words of 1:11 again, and the prophet like Moses
decisions.reason: The voice repeats what was said at Jesus' baptism (1:11; Psalm 2:7). "Listen to him" recalls Deuteronomy 18:15, where Moses says God will raise up a prophet like him, and Israel must listen to him.

decisions.choice: This is: the voice now speaks to the disciples about Jesus
decisions.reason: At the baptism the voice said "You are" to Jesus. Here it tells the three who he is and what they must do.

decisions.choice: overshadowing them: covering with its shadow, perhaps all on the mountain
decisions.reason: "Them" may mean Jesus with Moses and Elijah, or the disciples too. Mark does not make it clear.

decisions.choice: my dearly loved Son (B); my Son, and I love him (R)
decisions.reason: The same renderings as at 1:11.

decisions.choice: God says "Ta" for himself (with the setting) and "Con ấy" (that Son) for "him"; the verb is "phán"
decisions.reason: "Con" is a noun, capitalised, and takes no setting span; Vietnamese would not have God call his Son "Ngài". "phán" is kept for God speaking.

decisions.choice: The voice speaks in 해라체 and calls Jesus "그"
decisions.reason: God speaking uses the plain style (style guide, section 7a); a father does not use an honorific of his own son. The archaic "들으라" is replaced by the modern "들어라".

decisions.choice: escúchenlo / escuchadlo
decisions.reason: The command is plural, spoken to the three disciples, so it takes the ustedes / vosotros setting.

decisions.choice: une nuée (L, B); un nuage (R)
decisions.reason: "Nuée" is the French word used for the cloud of God’s presence (meaning decision on the cloud) and is still understood; Readable uses the everyday "nuage".

decisions.choice: o meu Filho, o amado (L); o meu Filho amado (B); o meu Filho, e eu o amo (R); escutem-no / Escutem o que ele diz
decisions.reason: The same words as the voice at the transfiguration in Matthew 17:5, so that the parallel passages read alike. "Escutar" says paying attention and obeying (m2, Deuteronomy 18:15) more plainly than "ouvir".

source.text: καὶ ἐξάπινα περιβλεψάμενοι οὐκέτι οὐδένα εἶδον ἀλλὰ τὸν Ἰησοῦν μόνον μεθ’ ἑαυτῶν.

records.literal_gloss: And suddenly having looked around, no longer no one they saw except Jesus alone with themselves.

en.L: And suddenly, looking around, they no longer saw anyone with them except Jesus alone.
en.B: All at once they looked around and saw no one there with them any more, only Jesus.
en.R: Suddenly the disciples looked around. Moses and Elijah were gone. Only Jesus was there with them.

vi.L: Và thình lình, nhìn quanh, họ không còn thấy ai ở với họ nữa ngoại trừ một mình Đức Giê-xu.
vi.B: Bỗng nhiên họ nhìn quanh thì không còn thấy ai ở đó với họ nữa, chỉ còn Đức Giê-xu.
vi.R: Bỗng nhiên các môn đồ nhìn quanh. Môi-se và Ê-li đã biến mất. Chỉ còn Đức Giê-xu ở đó với họ.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 문득 둘러보았을 때, 더 이상 아무도 보지 못하고, 오직 예수만 그들과 함께 [계셨다].
ko.B: 그들이 갑자기 둘러보니, 이제는 아무도 보이지 않고 예수만 그들과 함께 계셨다.
ko.R: 제자들이 갑자기 주위를 둘러보았다. 모세와 엘리야는 보이지 않았다. 예수만 그들과 함께 계셨다.

es.L: Y de repente, mirando alrededor, ya no vieron a nadie con ellos, sino a Jesús solo.
es.B: De pronto miraron a su alrededor y ya no vieron a nadie con ellos, sino solo a Jesús.
es.R: De repente los discípulos miraron a su alrededor. Moisés y Elías ya no estaban. Solo Jesús estaba allí con ellos.

fr.L: Et soudain, ayant regardé autour [d’eux], ils ne virent plus personne avec eux, sinon Jésus seul.
fr.B: Tout à coup, ils regardèrent autour d’eux et ne virent plus personne avec eux : il n’y avait plus que Jésus.
fr.R: Tout à coup, les disciples ont regardé autour d’eux. Moïse et Élie n’étaient plus là. Il n’y avait plus que Jésus avec eux.

sw.L: Na ghafla, walipotazama pande zote, hawakumwona tena mtu yeyote pamoja nao, ila Yesu peke {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.B: Ghafla walipotazama huku na huku, hawakumwona tena mtu yeyote pamoja nao, ila Yesu peke {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.R: Ghafla wanafunzi walitazama pande zote. Musa na Eliya walikuwa wametoweka. Yesu peke {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} ndiye aliyekuwa pamoja nao.

pt.L: E de repente, olhando ao redor, já não viram ninguém com eles, a não ser Jesus, sozinho.
pt.B: De repente, olharam em volta e não viram mais ninguém com eles, só Jesus.
pt.R: De repente, os discípulos olharam em volta. Moisés e Elias tinham ido embora. Só Jesus estava ali com eles.

decisions.choice: no longer ... no one: a double negative for emphasis
decisions.reason: The negatives strengthen each other: there was no one at all except Jesus.

decisions.choice: Jesus alone: the one they were told to listen to remains
decisions.reason: After the voice says "listen to him", Moses and Elijah are gone, and Jesus is left with them.

decisions.choice: Moses and Elijah were gone
decisions.reason: Readable says who had disappeared.

decisions.choice: [계셨다]
decisions.reason: Korean cannot hang "except Jesus alone" on "no longer saw anyone" without a verb of its own; Literal brackets it.

source.text: Καὶ καταβαινόντων αὐτῶν ἐκ τοῦ ὄρους διεστείλατο αὐτοῖς ἵνα μηδενὶ ἃ εἶδον διηγήσωνται, εἰ μὴ ὅταν ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐκ νεκρῶν ἀναστῇ.

records.literal_gloss: And descending of them from the mountain he instructed them that to no one what they had seen they should tell, except when the Son of Man out from [the] dead had risen.

en.L: And as they were coming down from the mountain, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} instructed them to tell no one what they had seen, except when the Son of Man had risen from [the] dead.
en.B: As they came down the mountain, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave them orders not to describe what they had seen to anyone until the Son of Man rose from the dead.
en.R: On the way down the mountain, Jesus ordered them to keep what they had seen to themselves. They were to tell no one until the Son of Man had come back to life from death.

vi.L: Và khi họ đang từ trên núi đi xuống, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dặn họ đừng thuật lại cho ai những gì họ đã thấy, trừ khi Con Người đã từ [cõi] chết sống lại.
vi.B: Khi họ đang xuống núi, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} căn dặn họ không được kể cho ai nghe những gì họ đã thấy, cho đến khi Con Người từ cõi chết sống lại.
vi.R: Trên đường xuống núi, Đức Giê-xu dặn họ phải giữ kín những gì họ đã thấy. Họ không được kể cho ai cả, cho đến khi Con Người từ cõi chết sống lại.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 산에서 내려올 때에, 그분은 그들에게 인자가 죽은 사람들 가운데서 살아날 때까지는 그들이 본 것을 아무에게도 이야기하지 말라고 명령하셨다.
ko.B: 산에서 내려올 때에, 예수께서는 인자가 죽은 사람들 가운데서 살아날 때까지 그들이 본 것을 아무에게도 말하지 말라고 그들에게 명령하셨다.
ko.R: 산에서 내려오는 길에 예수께서는 그들이 본 것을 아무에게도 말하지 말라고 명령하셨다. 인자, 곧 사람의 아들이 죽었다가 다시 살아날 때까지는 말하지 말아야 했다.

es.L: Y mientras bajaban del monte, les ordenó que no contaran a nadie lo que habían visto, sino cuando el Hijo del Hombre hubiera resucitado de [los] muertos.
es.B: Mientras bajaban del monte, les ordenó que no contaran a nadie lo que habían visto hasta que el Hijo del Hombre resucitara de entre los muertos.
es.R: Mientras bajaban del monte, Jesús les ordenó que no le contaran a nadie lo que habían visto. No debían decírselo a nadie hasta que el Hijo del Hombre volviera de la muerte a la vida.

fr.L: Et comme ils descendaient de la montagne, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur ordonna de ne raconter à personne ce qu’ils avaient vu, sinon quand le Fils de l’homme serait ressuscité d’entre [les] morts.
fr.B: Pendant qu’ils descendaient de la montagne, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur donna l’ordre de ne raconter à personne ce qu’ils avaient vu, jusqu’à ce que le Fils de l’homme soit ressuscité d’entre les morts.
fr.R: En descendant de la montagne, Jésus leur a ordonné de garder pour eux ce qu’ils avaient vu. Ils ne devaient le dire à personne avant que le Fils de l’homme soit revenu de la mort à la vie.

sw.L: Na walipokuwa wakishuka kutoka mlimani, aliwaagiza wasimsimulie mtu yeyote mambo waliyoyaona, isipokuwa wakati Mwana wa Adamu atakapokuwa amefufuka kutoka kwa wafu.
sw.B: Walipokuwa wakishuka mlimani, aliwakataza wasimweleze mtu yeyote waliyoyaona, mpaka Mwana wa Adamu atakapofufuka kutoka kwa wafu.
sw.R: Walipokuwa wakishuka mlimani, Yesu aliwaagiza wasimwambie mtu yeyote mambo waliyoyaona. Hawakupaswa kumwambia mtu mpaka Mwana wa Adamu atakapofufuka kutoka kwa wafu.

pt.L: E, enquanto desciam do monte, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes ordenou que não contassem a ninguém o que tinham visto, a não ser quando o Filho do Homem tivesse ressuscitado dentre [os] mortos.
pt.B: Enquanto desciam do monte, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes deu ordem de não contar a ninguém o que tinham visto, até que o Filho do Homem ressuscitasse dos mortos.
pt.R: Na descida do monte, Jesus mandou que eles guardassem para si o que tinham visto. Não deviam contar a ninguém até que o Filho do Homem tivesse voltado da morte para a vida.

decisions.choice: the Son of Man: Jesus speaking of himself
decisions.reason: Jesus uses this title for himself, as in 8:31 and 8:38. It recalls the one like a son of man in Daniel 7:13-14.

decisions.choice: except when: the silence lasts only until the resurrection
decisions.reason: This is the only command to silence in Mark with a time limit. After the resurrection the event could be understood and told.

decisions.choice: risen from the dead: raised to life again
decisions.reason: The phrase means coming back to bodily life, as Jesus said in 8:31.

decisions.choice: They were to keep quiet until
decisions.reason: Readable breaks the sentence in two and states the time limit plainly.

decisions.choice: "Con Người" for the Son of Man, capitalised, with no gender span
decisions.reason: A title, as in John; the same through Mark 9-10.

decisions.choice: "인자"; Readable adds "곧 사람의 아들" once in the chapter
decisions.reason: "인자" is the title in the Korean John (1:51; 12:23) and stays at every level; Readable explains it once per passage (style guide, section 6). It is never under the gender setting.

decisions.choice: the "except when" clause comes before the verb of telling
decisions.reason: Korean puts the time limit before the command it limits; nothing is added.

decisions.choice: el Hijo del Hombre
decisions.reason: As in John's Spanish: a title, capitalised, and never under the gender setting.

decisions.choice: Mwana wa Adamu (for the whole book)
decisions.reason: The settled Swahili title, as in John; "Adamu" is also a word for humankind (as in "binadamu"). Never under the gender setting. "Mwana wa Mtu" is more literal but unfamiliar. For review by a native speaker.

source.text: καὶ τὸν λόγον ἐκράτησαν πρὸς ἑαυτοὺς συζητοῦντες τί ἐστιν τὸ ἐκ νεκρῶν ἀναστῆναι.

records.literal_gloss: And that saying they kept to themselves, questioning what is the out from [the] dead to rise.

en.L: And they kept the word to themselves, questioning what the rising from [the] dead is.
en.B: They kept the matter to themselves, but they debated with one another what this "rising from the dead" might mean.
en.R: So they did not tell anyone. But they talked with each other about what Jesus meant by "rising from the dead."

vi.L: Và họ giữ lời ấy cho riêng mình, bàn luận với nhau sự sống lại từ [cõi] chết là gì.
vi.B: Họ giữ kín điều ấy, nhưng bàn luận với nhau xem "sống lại từ cõi chết" có nghĩa là gì.
vi.R: Vậy họ không kể cho ai. Nhưng họ bàn với nhau xem Đức Giê-xu muốn nói gì khi nói "sống lại từ cõi chết".

ko.L: 그리고 그들은 그 말씀을 마음에 간직하고, 죽은 사람들 가운데서 살아난다는 것이 무엇인지 서로 물으며 의논했다.
ko.B: 그들은 이 일을 자기들끼리만 간직했다. 그러나 죽은 사람들 가운데서 살아난다는 것이 무슨 뜻인지 서로 의논했다.
ko.R: 그래서 그들은 아무에게도 말하지 않았다. 그러나 예수께서 말씀하신 "죽은 사람들 가운데서 살아난다"는 것이 무슨 뜻인지 서로 이야기했다.

es.L: Y guardaron la palabra para sí, discutiendo qué es eso de resucitar de [los] muertos.
es.B: Guardaron el asunto entre ellos, pero discutían unos con otros qué querría decir eso de «resucitar de entre los muertos».
es.R: Así que no se lo contaron a nadie. Pero hablaban entre ellos sobre lo que Jesús quería decir con «resucitar de entre los muertos».

fr.L: Et ils gardèrent la parole pour eux, se demandant ce qu’est ressusciter d’entre [les] morts.
fr.B: Ils gardèrent la chose pour eux, mais ils se demandaient entre eux ce que pouvait bien signifier « ressusciter d’entre les morts ».
fr.R: Alors ils n’en ont parlé à personne. Mais ils discutaient entre eux de ce que Jésus voulait dire par « ressusciter d’entre les morts ».

sw.L: Na wakalishika neno hilo kati yao wenyewe, wakijadiliana ni nini huko kufufuka kutoka kwa wafu.
sw.B: Wakalishika jambo hilo bila kumwambia mtu, lakini wakajadiliana wao kwa wao maana ya huko "kufufuka kutoka kwa wafu."
sw.R: Basi hawakumwambia mtu yeyote. Lakini walizungumza wao kwa wao juu ya maana ya maneno ya Yesu, "kufufuka kutoka kwa wafu."

pt.L: E eles guardaram a palavra para si mesmos, discutindo o que é o ressuscitar dentre [os] mortos.
pt.B: Eles guardaram o assunto para si, mas discutiam entre si o que significaria esse "ressuscitar dos mortos".
pt.R: Por isso não contaram nada a ninguém. Mas conversavam entre eles sobre o que Jesus queria dizer com "ressuscitar dos mortos".

decisions.choice: to themselves: goes with kept, they told no one
alternatives: goes with questioning: they discussed it among themselves
decisions.reason: The phrase can belong with either verb. With "kept" it says they obeyed the order of 9:9; with "questioning" it says they discussed it among themselves. Both are true in the scene.

decisions.choice: the word: the saying, the command and what it said about rising
decisions.reason: The noun often means a matter or saying as a whole, as in 8:32.

decisions.choice: what rising from the dead is: they could not see how the Son of Man could rise before the end
alternatives: they did not believe in resurrection
decisions.reason: Many Jews expected all the righteous to rise together at the end of the age (Daniel 12:2). The disciples did not understand a single person rising first.

decisions.choice: what Jesus meant by
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that they were puzzling over Jesus' words.

decisions.choice: "그 말씀을 마음에 간직하고"
decisions.reason: "Kept to themselves" means they told no one (meaning decision); "간직하다" keeps the word without telling it, which is the Korean way of saying this. "말씀" because it is Jesus's word.

source.text: καὶ ἐπηρώτων αὐτὸν λέγοντες· Ὅτι λέγουσιν οἱ γραμματεῖς ὅτι Ἠλίαν δεῖ ἐλθεῖν πρῶτον;

records.literal_gloss: And they were asking him, saying, Why say the scribes that Elijah it behooves to come first?

en.L: And they were asking {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, saying, "Why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?"
en.B: They asked {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "Why do the scribes claim that Elijah has to come first?"
en.R: Then they asked Jesus, "Why do the teachers of God's law say that Elijah must come first?"

vi.L: Và họ hỏi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} rằng: "Sao các thầy thông giáo nói rằng Ê-li phải đến trước?"
vi.B: Họ hỏi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Sao các thầy thông giáo lại bảo rằng Ê-li phải đến trước?"
vi.R: Rồi họ hỏi Đức Giê-xu: "Tại sao các thầy dạy luật nói rằng Ê-li phải đến trước?"

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 그분께 물으며 말했다. "어찌하여 율법학자들은 엘리야가 먼저 와야 한다고 말합니까?"
ko.B: 그들이 예수께 물었다. "율법학자들은 왜 엘리야가 먼저 와야 한다고 말합니까?"
ko.R: 그들이 예수께 물었다. "율법을 가르치는 선생들은 왜 엘리야가 먼저 와야 한다고 말합니까?"

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} preguntaban, diciendo: «¿Por qué dicen los escribas que Elías tiene que venir primero?».
es.B: Le preguntaron: «¿Por qué afirman los escribas que Elías tiene que venir primero?».
es.R: Entonces {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} preguntaron a Jesús: «¿Por qué dicen los maestros de la ley que Elías debe venir primero?».

fr.L: Et ils {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}interrogeaient, disant : « Pourquoi les scribes disent-ils qu’il faut qu’Élie vienne d’abord ? »
fr.B: Ils {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} demandèrent : « Pourquoi les scribes affirment-ils qu’Élie doit venir d’abord ? »
fr.R: Puis ils ont demandé à Jésus : « Pourquoi les spécialistes de la Loi disent-ils qu’Élie doit venir en premier ? »

sw.L: Na wakamwuliza, wakisema, "Mbona waandishi wanasema kwamba imempasa Eliya kuja kwanza?"
sw.B: Wakamwuliza, "Kwa nini waandishi wanadai kwamba Eliya lazima aje kwanza?"
sw.R: Kisha wakamwuliza Yesu, "Kwa nini walimu wa sheria wanasema kwamba Eliya lazima aje kwanza?"

pt.L: E eles {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} interrogavam, dizendo: "Por que os escribas dizem que Elias deve vir primeiro?"
pt.B: Eles {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} perguntaram: "Por que os escribas afirmam que Elias tem de vir primeiro?"
pt.R: Então eles perguntaram a Jesus: "Por que os mestres da Lei dizem que Elias tem de vir primeiro?"

decisions.choice: why: the small word here opens a question
alternatives: that: introducing a statement, the scribes say that
decisions.reason: The word usually means "that", but at the head of a question it can mean "why", as in 9:28.

decisions.choice: Elijah must come first: the promise of Malachi 4:5-6
alternatives: a saying of the scribes only
decisions.reason: God promised to send Elijah the prophet before the great day of the Lord. The scribes taught that he would come first, before the Messiah.

decisions.choice: first: before the end, and before the Messiah
alternatives: before the Son of Man rises
decisions.reason: The disciples have just seen Elijah and heard Jesus speak of his own death and rising. They ask how this fits the order the scribes taught.

decisions.choice: the teachers of God's law
decisions.reason: As in earlier chapters, Readable says who the scribes were.

decisions.choice: "các thầy thông giáo" (L, B); "các thầy dạy luật" (R) for the scribes
decisions.reason: As John 8:3: the Protestant word at Literal and Balanced, a plain description at Readable. The same through Mark 9-10.

decisions.choice: "율법학자" (L, B); "율법을 가르치는 선생" (R), through chapter 9
decisions.reason: As in Mark 3 and the Korean John (8:3): "율법학자" says what these men were; "서기관" (clerk) is the older church word.

decisions.choice: escribas (L, B); maestros de la ley (R)
decisions.reason: As in John 8:3 in Spanish: Readable says what the scribes were, teachers of God's law.

decisions.choice: les scribes (L, B); les spécialistes de la Loi (R)
decisions.reason: As the French John (8:3). "Scribes" is the established French term; Readable says what they were, experts in the Law of Moses. Used the same way in 9:14.

decisions.choice: waandishi (L, B); walimu wa sheria (R)
alternatives: walimu wa sheria at every level
decisions.reason: As in John 8:3: "waandishi" (writers) is the established Swahili name for the scribes, the experts who copied, taught and applied the law. Readable says what they did, as the English Readable says "teachers of God's law". For the whole of Mark 9 and 10.

source.text: ὁ δὲ ἔφη αὐτοῖς· Ἠλίας μὲν ἐλθὼν πρῶτον ἀποκαθιστάνει πάντα, καὶ πῶς γέγραπται ἐπὶ τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἵνα πολλὰ πάθῃ καὶ ἐξουδενηθῇ;

records.literal_gloss: And he was saying to them, Elijah indeed having come first restores all things; and how has it been written of the Son of Man that many things he should suffer and be set at naught?

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "Elijah indeed comes first and restores all things; and how is it written of the Son of Man that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} should suffer many things and be treated with contempt?
en.B: He told them, "Elijah does come first and set everything right. Then why does Scripture say that the Son of Man is to suffer much and be scorned?
en.R: Jesus answered, "It is true that Elijah comes first and makes everything right again. But then why do the Scriptures say that the Son of Man will suffer a great deal, and that people will treat {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} as worthless?

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Ê-li quả thật đến trước và khôi phục mọi sự; vậy thì sao có lời chép về Con Người rằng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phải chịu nhiều đau khổ và bị khinh dể?
vi.B: Ngài bảo họ: "Đúng là Ê-li đến trước và phục hồi mọi sự. Thế thì tại sao Kinh Thánh lại chép rằng Con Người phải chịu nhiều đau khổ và bị khinh bỉ?
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu đáp: "Đúng là Ê-li đến trước và làm cho mọi sự trở lại đúng như cũ. Nhưng vậy thì tại sao Kinh Thánh lại nói rằng Con Người sẽ chịu nhiều đau khổ, và người ta sẽ coi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} như không ra gì?

ko.L: 그러자 그분이 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "엘리야가 과연 먼저 와서 모든 것을 회복한다. 그런데 인자에 대해서는 그가 많은 고난을 받고 멸시를 당할 것이라고 어떻게 기록되어 있느냐?
ko.B: 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "엘리야가 먼저 와서 모든 것을 바로잡는 것은 사실이다. 그렇다면 인자가 많은 고난을 받고 멸시를 당해야 한다고 성경에 기록된 것은 어찌 된 일이냐?
ko.R: 예수께서 대답하셨다. "엘리야가 먼저 와서 모든 것을 다시 바르게 하는 것은 맞다. 그렇다면 성경은 왜 인자가 많은 고난을 받고, 사람들이 그를 하찮게 여길 것이라고 말하느냐?

es.L: Y les dijo: «Elías, en verdad, viene primero y restaura todas las cosas; ¿y cómo está escrito acerca del Hijo del Hombre que padezca mucho y sea tenido en nada?
es.B: Él les respondió: «Es cierto que Elías viene primero y pone todo en orden. Entonces, ¿por qué dice la Escritura que el Hijo del Hombre tiene que sufrir mucho y ser despreciado?
es.R: Jesús respondió: «Es verdad que Elías viene primero y vuelve a poner todo en orden. Pero entonces, ¿por qué dicen las Escrituras que el Hijo del Hombre sufrirá mucho y que la gente {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} tratará como si no valiera nada?

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit : « Élie, certes, vient d’abord et rétablit toutes choses ; et comment est-il écrit au sujet du Fils de l’homme qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} doit souffrir beaucoup et être traité avec mépris ?
fr.B: Il leur répondit : « Oui, Élie vient d’abord et remet tout en ordre. Mais alors, pourquoi l’Écriture dit-elle que le Fils de l’homme doit beaucoup souffrir et être méprisé ?
fr.R: Jésus a répondu : « C’est vrai, Élie vient d’abord et remet tout en ordre. Mais alors, pourquoi les Écritures disent-elles que le Fils de l’homme souffrira beaucoup et que les gens {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} traiteront comme s’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne valait rien ?

sw.L: Naye akawaambia, "Ni kweli, Eliya akiisha kuja kwanza, anayatengeneza upya mambo yote; basi imeandikwaje kuhusu Mwana wa Adamu kwamba atapata mateso mengi na kudharauliwa?
sw.B: Akawaambia, "Ndiyo, Eliya anakuja kwanza na kuyatengeneza mambo yote. Basi kwa nini Maandiko yanasema kwamba Mwana wa Adamu atateseka sana na kudharauliwa?
sw.R: Yesu akawajibu, "Ni kweli kwamba Eliya anakuja kwanza na kuyarudisha mambo yote katika hali yake nzuri. Lakini basi, kwa nini Maandiko yanasema kwamba Mwana wa Adamu atateseka sana, na kwamba watu watamwona kuwa si kitu?

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes disse: "Elias, de fato, vem primeiro e restaura todas as coisas; e como está escrito a respeito do Filho do Homem que sofra muitas coisas e seja desprezado?
pt.B: Ele lhes respondeu: "Elias vem primeiro, sim, e põe tudo em ordem. Então por que a Escritura diz que o Filho do Homem vai sofrer muito e ser tratado com desprezo?
pt.R: Jesus respondeu: "É verdade que Elias vem primeiro e põe tudo em ordem de novo. Mas então por que as Escrituras dizem que o Filho do Homem vai sofrer muito e que as pessoas vão tratá-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} como alguém sem valor?

decisions.choice: indeed: Jesus grants the scribes' point
decisions.reason: The small word agrees with the statement before the next clause adds a "but".

decisions.choice: restores all things: puts all things back in right order
alternatives: brings the world to an end
decisions.reason: Malachi 4:6 says Elijah will turn the hearts of fathers to children and children to fathers.

decisions.choice: it is written: Scripture speaks of the suffering of the Son of Man
decisions.reason: Jesus does not name the passage. Isaiah 53:3 and Psalm 22 speak of one who is despised and suffers. Mark gives no single text.

decisions.choice: how: a question that sets two teachings side by side
decisions.reason: If Elijah sets everything right, why must the Son of Man suffer? Jesus' answer in 9:13 is that Elijah has come and was himself mistreated.

decisions.choice: be treated with contempt: be counted as nothing
decisions.reason: The verb means to treat as worthless. It is a different word from the one used for being rejected in 8:31.

decisions.choice: the Scriptures
decisions.reason: Readable names what is written.

decisions.choice: "성경에" (B); "성경은" (R)
decisions.reason: "It is written" means written in Scripture; Balanced and Readable name it, as the English Readable does.

source.text: ἀλλὰ λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι καὶ Ἠλίας ἐλήλυθεν, καὶ ἐποίησαν αὐτῷ ὅσα ἤθελον, καθὼς γέγραπται ἐπ’ αὐτόν.

records.literal_gloss: But I say to you that also Elijah has come, and they did to him whatever they desired, as it has been written of him.

en.L: But I say to you that Elijah also has come, and they did to him whatever they wanted, just as it is written of him."
en.B: But I tell you that Elijah has in fact come, and they did to him as they pleased, just as it is written about him."
en.R: But I tell you, Elijah has already come. And people did whatever they wanted to him, just as the Scriptures say about him."

vi.L: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con rằng Ê-li cũng đã đến rồi, và họ đã đối xử với ông ấy tùy theo ý họ muốn, như đã có lời chép về ông ấy."
vi.B: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con, Ê-li thật đã đến rồi, và người ta đã đối xử với ông theo ý họ muốn, đúng như Kinh Thánh đã chép về ông."
vi.R: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con: Ê-li đã đến rồi. Người ta đã làm với ông bất cứ điều gì họ muốn, đúng như Kinh Thánh đã nói về ông."

ko.L: 그러나 내가 너희에게 말한다. 엘리야도 이미 왔다. 그리고 그에 대하여 기록된 대로, 사람들은 자기들이 원하는 대로 그에게 행하였다."
ko.B: 그러나 내가 너희에게 말한다. 엘리야는 이미 왔다. 그리고 그에 대하여 기록된 대로, 사람들은 그를 자기들 마음대로 대하였다."
ko.R: 그러나 내가 너희에게 말한다. 엘리야는 벌써 왔다. 그런데 사람들은 그에게 하고 싶은 대로 다 했다. 성경에 그에 대해 쓰여 있는 그대로였다."

es.L: Pero {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que también Elías ha venido, y le hicieron cuanto quisieron, tal como está escrito de él».
es.B: Pero yo {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que Elías de hecho ya vino, y le hicieron lo que quisieron, tal como está escrito acerca de él».
es.R: Pero {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que Elías ya vino. Y la gente le hizo todo lo que quiso, tal como dicen las Escrituras acerca de él».

fr.L: Mais je vous dis qu’Élie aussi est venu, et ils lui ont fait tout ce qu’ils voulaient, comme il est écrit à son sujet. »
fr.B: Mais je vous le dis : Élie est bel et bien venu, et ils l’ont traité comme ils l’ont voulu, ainsi qu’il est écrit à son sujet. »
fr.R: Mais je vous le dis : Élie est déjà venu. Et les gens lui ont fait tout ce qu’ils voulaient, comme les Écritures le disent à son sujet. »

sw.L: Lakini nawaambia kwamba Eliya naye amekwisha kuja, na wakamtendea yote waliyotaka, kama ilivyoandikwa juu yake."
sw.B: Lakini nawaambia, Eliya amekwisha kuja kweli, nao wakamtendea kama walivyopenda, kama vile ilivyoandikwa kumhusu."
sw.R: Lakini nawaambia, Eliya amekwisha kuja. Na watu walimtendea lolote walilotaka, kama Maandiko yanavyosema juu yake."

pt.L: Mas eu lhes digo que Elias também já veio, e fizeram com ele tudo o que quiseram, como está escrito a respeito dele."
pt.B: Mas eu lhes digo que Elias de fato já veio, e fizeram com ele o que bem entenderam, como está escrito a respeito dele."
pt.R: Mas eu digo a vocês: Elias já veio. E as pessoas fizeram com ele tudo o que quiseram, como as Escrituras dizem sobre ele."

decisions.choice: Elijah has come: John the Baptizer
decisions.reason: Mark does not name him here, but he has shown John dressed like Elijah (1:6; 2 Kings 1:8) and told how Herod killed him (6:17-29). Matthew 17:13 says the disciples understood he meant John.

decisions.choice: as it is written of him: what Scripture says of Elijah
alternatives: a prophecy of John by name
decisions.reason: Scripture tells how Jezebel sought Elijah's life (1 Kings 19:2, 10). What happened to John matches what Elijah suffered.

decisions.choice: they did: those who opposed him, Herod and Herodias in John's case
decisions.reason: The subject is not named.

decisions.choice: already; people
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that Elijah's coming is past and names the subject in general terms.

decisions.choice: "các con" for "you" (the three disciples)
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks to his disciples as "các con" and of himself as "Ta", as in John; the same wherever he speaks to the disciples in Mark 9-10.

decisions.choice: "사람들은" without brackets
decisions.reason: Korean needs a subject for "they did"; the Greek verb's own ending carries it, so it is grammar rather than an added word.

source.text: Καὶ ἐλθόντες πρὸς τοὺς μαθητὰς εἶδον ὄχλον πολὺν περὶ αὐτοὺς καὶ γραμματεῖς συζητοῦντας πρὸς αὐτούς.

records.literal_gloss: And having come to the disciples they saw a crowd great around them, and scribes arguing with them.

en.L: And when they came to the disciples, they saw a large crowd around them and scribes arguing with them.
en.B: When they got back to the other disciples, they found a large crowd surrounding them, and some scribes disputing with them.
en.R: When Jesus and the three came back to the other disciples, they saw a big crowd around them. Some teachers of God's law were arguing with them.

vi.L: Và khi đến với các môn đồ, họ thấy một đám đông lớn vây quanh họ, và các thầy thông giáo đang tranh luận với họ.
vi.B: Khi trở lại với các môn đồ khác, họ thấy một đám đông lớn vây quanh các môn đồ, và có mấy thầy thông giáo đang tranh cãi với họ.
vi.R: Khi Đức Giê-xu và ba môn đồ trở lại với các môn đồ khác, họ thấy một đám đông lớn vây quanh các môn đồ. Có mấy thầy dạy luật đang tranh cãi với họ.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 제자들에게 와서 보니, 큰 무리가 그들을 둘러싸고 있고, 율법학자들이 그들과 논쟁하고 있었다.
ko.B: 그들이 다른 제자들에게 돌아와 보니, 큰 무리가 제자들을 둘러싸고 있었고, 율법학자 몇 사람이 그들과 논쟁하고 있었다.
ko.R: 예수와 세 제자가 나머지 제자들에게 돌아왔다. 그런데 많은 사람이 제자들을 둘러싸고 있었다. 율법을 가르치는 선생 몇 사람이 제자들과 말다툼을 하고 있었다.

es.L: Y al llegar junto a los discípulos, vieron una gran multitud alrededor de ellos y a escribas que discutían con ellos.
es.B: Cuando volvieron adonde estaban los otros discípulos, encontraron una gran multitud a su alrededor, y a algunos escribas que discutían con ellos.
es.R: Cuando Jesús y los tres volvieron adonde estaban los otros discípulos, vieron mucha gente alrededor de ellos. Algunos maestros de la ley estaban discutiendo con ellos.

fr.L: Et étant venus vers les disciples, ils virent une grande foule autour d’eux, et des scribes qui discutaient avec eux.
fr.B: Quand ils revinrent auprès des autres disciples, ils trouvèrent une grande foule autour d’eux, et des scribes qui débattaient avec eux.
fr.R: Quand Jésus et les trois sont revenus vers les autres disciples, ils ont vu une grande foule autour d’eux. Des spécialistes de la Loi discutaient avec eux.

sw.L: Na walipofika kwa wanafunzi, waliona umati mkubwa ukiwazunguka, na waandishi wakijadiliana nao.
sw.B: Walipowafikia wanafunzi wengine, waliwakuta wamezungukwa na umati mkubwa, na baadhi ya waandishi wakibishana nao.
sw.R: Yesu na wale watatu waliporudi kwa wanafunzi wengine, waliona umati mkubwa wa watu umewazunguka. Baadhi ya walimu wa sheria walikuwa wakibishana nao.

pt.L: E, chegando aos discípulos, viram uma grande multidão em volta deles e escribas discutindo com eles.
pt.B: Quando voltaram para junto dos outros discípulos, encontraram uma grande multidão em volta deles e alguns escribas discutindo com eles.
pt.R: Jesus e os três voltaram para onde estavam os outros discípulos. Eles viram muita gente em volta deles. Alguns mestres da Lei estavam discutindo com eles.

decisions.choice: having come, they saw: plural, the reading of the SBLGNT
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts have the singular, making Jesus the one who saw. The SBLGNT reads the plural, which includes the three disciples. Reviewers should check this against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: the disciples: the others who had stayed below
decisions.reason: Jesus had taken only three up the mountain.

decisions.choice: arguing: disputing
decisions.reason: The same verb as in 9:10 and 8:11. Here it is a dispute, likely over the disciples' failure (9:18).

decisions.choice: the other disciples (B, R); Jesus and the three (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make clear which disciples are meant.

source.text: καὶ εὐθὺς πᾶς ὁ ὄχλος ἰδόντες αὐτὸν ἐξεθαμβήθησαν, καὶ προστρέχοντες ἠσπάζοντο αὐτόν.

records.literal_gloss: And immediately all the crowd, having seen him, were greatly amazed, and running to [him] were greeting him.

en.L: And immediately all the crowd, when they saw {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, were greatly amazed, and running up, they greeted {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: As soon as the people saw {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, the whole crowd was overcome with wonder, and they ran up to greet {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: As soon as the people saw Jesus, they were very surprised. They all ran to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to welcome {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

vi.L: Và lập tức cả đám đông, khi thấy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, đều rất kinh ngạc, và chạy đến chào {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Vừa thấy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, cả đám đông đều hết sức kinh ngạc và chạy đến chào {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Vừa thấy Đức Giê-xu, mọi người đều rất ngạc nhiên. Họ chạy đến chào đón {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그리고 곧 온 무리가 그분을 보고 몹시 놀라며, 달려와서 그분께 인사했다.
ko.B: 온 무리가 예수를 보자 곧바로 몹시 놀라며, 달려와서 예수께 인사했다.
ko.R: 사람들은 예수를 보자 바로 깜짝 놀랐다. 그리고 모두 예수께 달려가서 반갑게 맞이했다.

es.L: Y enseguida toda la multitud, al verlo, quedó muy asombrada, y acercándose corriendo, {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} saludaban.
es.B: En cuanto la gente {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} vio, toda la multitud quedó asombrada, y corrieron a saludarlo.
es.R: En cuanto la gente vio a Jesús, se sorprendió mucho. Todos corrieron hacia {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} para saludarlo.

fr.L: Et aussitôt toute la foule, {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} voyant, fut saisie d’étonnement, et accourant, ils {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} saluaient.
fr.B: Dès que la foule {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}aperçut, elle fut saisie d’étonnement, et tous accoururent pour {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} saluer.
fr.R: Dès que les gens ont vu Jésus, ils ont été très surpris. Ils ont tous couru vers {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} pour {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} saluer.

sw.L: Na mara moja umati wote, walipomwona, walishangaa mno, na wakimkimbilia, wakamsalimu.
sw.B: Mara tu watu walipomwona, umati wote ukastaajabu sana, wakamkimbilia ili kumsalimu.
sw.R: Mara tu watu walipomwona Yesu, walishangaa sana. Wote wakamkimbilia ili kumsalimu.

pt.L: E imediatamente toda a multidão, ao vê-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}}, ficou muito espantada e, correndo até [{{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}], {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} saudavam.
pt.B: Assim que viram Jesus, todos na multidão ficaram tomados de espanto e correram para saudá-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}}.
pt.R: Logo que as pessoas viram Jesus, ficaram muito surpresas. Todas correram até {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} para recebê-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}}.

decisions.choice: greatly amazed: overcome with astonishment
decisions.reason: Mark uses this strong word only here and at 14:33 and 16:5-6.

decisions.choice: why they were amazed: Mark does not say
decisions.reason: Some suggest Jesus' face still showed the glory of the mountain, as Moses' face shone after Sinai (Exodus 34:29-30). Mark gives no reason; it may simply be his sudden arrival at the right moment.

decisions.choice: all the crowd ... having seen: plural forms with a singular crowd
decisions.reason: The crowd is thought of as many people, so the participles are plural.

decisions.choice: as soon as
decisions.reason: As in earlier chapters, Literal says "immediately" and the other levels vary the phrase.

decisions.choice: "lập tức" (L); "vừa ...", "ngay", "liền" (B, R) for "immediately"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps one word for Mark's frequent "immediately"; Balanced and Readable use the word the sentence needs. The same through Mark 9-10.

decisions.choice: "곧" (L); "곧바로" (B); "바로" (R) for euthys, through chapter 9
decisions.reason: As in Mark 3: one Korean word per level keeps Mark's pace visible; "즉시" sounds administrative in narrative.

decisions.choice: enseguida (L); en cuanto (B, R)
decisions.reason: Mark's frequent "immediately": Literal says "enseguida"; Balanced and Readable fold it into "en cuanto", as the English does with "as soon as".

decisions.choice: mara moja (L); mara tu (B, R)
decisions.reason: Mark's frequent "immediately" is "mara moja" at Literal throughout these chapters. Here Balanced and Readable join it to the seeing, "mara tu ... walipomwona" (as soon as they saw), as the English says "as soon as".

decisions.choice: imediatamente (L); Assim que (B); Logo que (R)
decisions.reason: As the English varies Mark's frequent "immediately" above Literal, Balanced and Readable use the ordinary Portuguese time clause.

source.text: καὶ ἐπηρώτησεν αὐτούς· Τί συζητεῖτε πρὸς αὑτούς;

records.literal_gloss: And he asked them, What are you disputing with them?

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} asked them, "What are you disputing with them?"
en.B: He asked them, "What are you arguing with them about?"
en.R: Jesus asked them, "What are you arguing with them about?"

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hỏi họ: "Các con đang tranh luận gì với họ?"
vi.B: Ngài hỏi họ: "Các con đang tranh cãi với họ về chuyện gì vậy?"
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu hỏi họ: "Các con đang cãi nhau với họ về chuyện gì?"

ko.L: 그리고 그분이 그들에게 물으셨다. "너희는 그들과 무엇을 논쟁하고 있느냐?"
ko.B: 예수께서 그들에게 물으셨다. "너희는 저 사람들과 무엇을 가지고 논쟁하고 있느냐?"
ko.R: 예수께서 제자들에게 물으셨다. "너희는 저 사람들과 무엇 때문에 말다툼을 하고 있느냐?"

es.L: Y les preguntó: «¿Qué {{plural_you:discuten|discutís}} con ellos?».
es.B: Les preguntó: «¿Sobre qué {{plural_you:discuten|discutís}} con ellos?».
es.R: Jesús les preguntó: «¿De qué {{plural_you:están|estáis}} discutiendo con ellos?».

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les interrogea : « De quoi discutez-vous avec eux ? »
fr.B: Il leur demanda : « De quoi débattez-vous avec eux ? »
fr.R: Jésus leur a demandé : « À propos de quoi est-ce que vous vous disputez avec eux ? »

sw.L: Naye akawauliza, "Mnajadiliana nini nao?"
sw.B: Akawauliza, "Mnabishana nao juu ya nini?"
sw.R: Yesu akawauliza, "Mnabishana nao juu ya nini?"

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes perguntou: "O que vocês estão discutindo com eles?"
pt.B: Ele lhes perguntou: "Sobre o que vocês estão discutindo com eles?"
pt.R: Jesus perguntou aos discípulos: "Vocês estão discutindo com eles sobre o quê?"

decisions.choice: them ... with them: Jesus asks the disciples what they are disputing with the scribes
alternatives: what are you disputing among yourselves
decisions.reason: The pronouns are not explained. Since the scribes were arguing with the disciples (9:14), Jesus most likely asks his disciples. Some manuscripts read the second pronoun as "among yourselves".

decisions.choice: disputing: the same verb as arguing in 9:14
decisions.reason: Jesus takes up the word Mark used for the scene.

decisions.choice: What are you arguing with them about?
alternatives: What are you disputing with them?
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use the everyday verb and English word order.

decisions.choice: "các con" for "you"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the question as put to the disciples about the scribes, so Jesus uses the word for his disciples.

source.text: καὶ ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῷ εἷς ἐκ τοῦ ὄχλου· Διδάσκαλε, ἤνεγκα τὸν υἱόν μου πρὸς σέ, ἔχοντα πνεῦμα ἄλαλον·

records.literal_gloss: And answered him one out of the crowd, Teacher, I brought the son of me to you, having a spirit mute;

en.L: And one of the crowd answered {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "Teacher, I brought my son to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, [because he] has a mute spirit;
en.B: A man in the crowd answered {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "Teacher, I brought my son to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. He has a spirit that makes him unable to speak.
en.R: A man in the crowd answered, "Teacher, I brought my son to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. He has an evil spirit in him that keeps him from talking.

vi.L: Và một người trong đám đông đáp lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Thưa Thầy, tôi đã đem con trai tôi đến với Thầy, [vì cháu] bị linh câm [ám];
vi.B: Một người trong đám đông thưa với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Thưa Thầy, tôi đã đem con trai tôi đến với Thầy. Cháu bị một linh làm cho câm, không nói được.
vi.R: Một người trong đám đông trả lời: "Thưa Thầy, tôi đã đem con trai tôi đến với Thầy. Cháu bị tà linh nhập vào, làm cho cháu không nói được.

ko.L: 그러자 무리 가운데 한 사람이 그분께 대답했다. "선생님, 말 못 하게 하는 영이 들린 제 아들을 선생님께 데려왔습니다.
ko.B: 무리 가운데 한 사람이 예수께 대답했다. "선생님, 제 아들을 선생님께 데려왔습니다. 그 아이는 말을 못 하게 하는 영이 들렸습니다.
ko.R: 무리 가운데 한 사람이 대답했다. "선생님, 제 아들을 선생님께 데려왔습니다. 아들 속에 악한 영이 들어 있어서 아이가 말을 하지 못합니다.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} respondió uno de la multitud: «Maestro, {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} traje a mi hijo, que tiene un espíritu mudo;
es.B: Un hombre de la multitud {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} respondió: «Maestro, {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} traje a mi hijo. Tiene un espíritu que no lo deja hablar.
es.R: Un hombre de la multitud respondió: «Maestro, {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} traje a mi hijo. Tiene dentro un espíritu maligno que no lo deja hablar.

fr.L: Et quelqu’un de la foule {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} répondit : « Maître, je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}ai amené mon fils, [parce qu’il] a un esprit muet ;
